priority_standards_2016_vs_2026.title: Selection, installation and maintenance of portable first-aid fire extinguishers - Code of practice
priority_standards_2016_vs_2026.delta: OLDER REVISION - 2016 cites the 4th revision, 2026 the 5th. One revision cycle apart.

priority_standards_2016_vs_2026.title: Selection, installation and maintenance of automatic fire detection and alarm system - Code of practice
priority_standards_2016_vs_2026.delta: MUCH OLDER REVISION - an 18-year-old standard revision cited in 2016 vs a same-year-as-the-code revision in 2026. Largest single revision gap found in this comparison.

priority_standards_2016_vs_2026.title: Design and installation of fixed automatic sprinkler fire extinguishing system - Code of practice
priority_standards_2016_vs_2026.delta: OLDER REVISION - roughly two decades older.

priority_standards_2016_vs_2026.title: Code of practice for installation and maintenance of internal fire hydrants and hose reels on premises
priority_standards_2016_vs_2026.delta: UNCHANGED - identical citation in both editions. Confirms not every standard was refreshed for 2026.

priority_standards_2016_vs_2026.is_number_2016: IS 13039 : 1991 (in the numbered [4(n)] cross-reference list) / IS 13039 : 2014 (also appears once in the alphabetical List of Standards, likely reflecting a later amendment slip bound into this printing)
priority_standards_2016_vs_2026.title: External hydrant systems - Provision and maintenance - Code of practice
priority_standards_2016_vs_2026.delta: AMBIGUOUS - this particular 2016 printing shows both the 1991 and 2014 revisions cited in different places, so no clean single-answer delta can be asserted; at minimum the 2014 revision was already in circulation and possibly already adopted by the time this copy was printed. Flag for manual confirmation rather than asserting a change.

priority_standards_2016_vs_2026.is_number_2016: not found in the 2016 List of Standards or clause-reference list
priority_standards_2016_vs_2026.title: Fire safety in commercial kitchen - Guidelines
priority_standards_2016_vs_2026.delta: NEW STANDARD IN 2026. 2016 has NO equivalent external-standard reference for commercial kitchens because 2016 instead devotes its own in-code Annex G ('Commercial Kitchens') to the topic. 2026 apparently REMOVED its own kitchen annex and now defers entirely to this external IS standard instead - a genuine structural change in how the two editions handle commercial kitchens, not just a revision-year update.

priority_standards_2016_vs_2026.title: Fire doors and doorsets - Specification
priority_standards_2016_vs_2026.delta: NOT LOCATED IN 2016 - either genuinely new to 2026, or cited in 2016 under a different/older standard number not captured by this pass's keyword search. Flag for a follow-up targeted search of the full 2016 List of Standards (only a subset was read closely) before concluding it is entirely new.

priority_standards_2016_vs_2026.title: Criteria for structural safety of tall concrete buildings
priority_standards_2016_vs_2026.delta: NEW STANDARD IN 2026 - consistent with 2026's generally greater emphasis on tall/high-rise buildings (also reflected in its higher 24 m high-rise threshold vs 2016's 15 m, and its more elaborate Annex D high-rise provisions).

priority_standards_2016_vs_2026.title: Accessibility in built environment for older adults and persons with disabilities
priority_standards_2016_vs_2026.delta: NEW STANDARD IN 2026 - no accessibility-for-disabled-and-elderly standard reference found anywhere in the 2016 Part 4 text reviewed. This tracks with there being no refuge-area wheelchair-space provision found explicitly in 2016's Annex E either (2016's Annex E does mention 'one wheelchair space... 0.9 m2 for every 200 occupants' in its refuge-area rule, so SOME accessibility consideration exists in 2016 text - but no dedicated cross-referenced IS standard for it).

A family of occupancy-specific 'Code of practice for fire safety of industrial buildings' standards (cotton ginning, electrical generating stations, viscose rayon, cotton textile mills, general storage/warehousing including cold storage, coal pulverizers, jute mills, aluminium/magnesium powder factories, tea factories, saw mills/wood works, paint and varnish factories, chemical industries-rubber and plastic).
other_2016_only_standards_of_note.note: IS 3594 (general storage and warehousing including cold storage) is notable: 2016 cites IS 3594:1991 (first revision) while the 2026 dataset's own is_standards_referenced.json cites 'IS 3594 : 2024 (second revision)' - confirming this specific storage/warehousing fire-safety standard was substantially updated (a 33-year gap) between the two code editions.

ingestion_guidance: Given this dataset's legacy/secondary status, prioritize using it only to answer 'what did the building's original 2016 approval require' questions for edition-comparison purposes - always resolve any live compliance question against the 2026 dataset's is_standards_referenced.json instead, per meta.json's live_edition_note.
